title: Guide — how to help
intro: Home and homelab notes for family and support. DockFire never stores passwords. Health checks are DNS + TCP from the cluster — they tell you if a target answers, not if you can log in.

entries.name: Internet (ISP)
entries.summary: Fidium fiber primary; Starlink on UniFi WAN2 as failover-only backup.
used_for: Coarse WAN path health (TCP to 1.1.1.1:443)
If red, check UniFi WAN Fiber first, then Starlink Backup
Provider contacts live on the Home tab (Fidium, Starlink, SMUD, PG&E, water, garbage)

entries.name: Ranch
entries.summary: Remote UDM Ranch over UniFi SD-WAN mesh from Chapman Residence.
used_for: Open the Ranch tab for gateway + tunnel high-level health
Probe is LAN-only via private overlay (Ranch Gateway)
If red, check UniFi site VPN “UDM - Ranch” before blaming ranch gear

entries.name: Tesla Energy
entries.summary: Powerwall gateway at tesla.dataknife.net.
used_for: Open the local Powerwall UI when on the house network
Live SoC/meter JSON needs token — Tesla app or Fleet API; core HA Tesla integration was removed

entries.name: Enphase Envoy
entries.summary: Solar gateway at envoy.dataknife.net — official HA enphase_envoy integration.
used_for: Confirm Envoy is up (HTTPS answers)
Production stats via HA or Envoy token

entries.name: Pool · WaterGuru / Hayward
entries.summary: WaterGuru is cloud-only; OmniLogic is on omnilogic.dataknife.net (UDP 10444 local API).
used_for: WaterGuru HA: igorek24/waterguru-home-assistant (cloud account)
Hayward HA cloud: built-in omnilogic; local: cryptk/haomnilogic-local
DockFire TCP health cannot probe OmniLogic UDP yet

entries.name: 1. Find the service
entries.summary: Use Search or Local services. Match the name someone mentioned (or the URL).
used_for: Open the card if you just need to get in
Note the audience tag: Everyone, Support, or Admin

entries.name: 2. Check the status dot
entries.summary: Green = reachable. Red / amber = something is wrong on the path to that admin UI.
used_for: If it is red, open Infrastructure health for detail
Then open Pulseblade for deeper findings when available

entries.name: 3. Sign in if asked
entries.summary: Most lab apps use Authentik. Start at Sign in under Local services.
used_for: If login fails, capture the exact error before retrying forever
Do not share passwords in chat — reset through Authentik or an admin

entries.name: Proxmox
entries.summary: Primary hypervisor for VMs and containers.
used_for: Power guests on/off and check node health
Snapshots and maintenance windows

entries.name: PegaProx / PDM
entries.summary: Helpers around the Proxmox fleet.
used_for: Faster cluster views than stock PVE
Multi-node management via Datacenter Manager

entries.name: iDRAC
entries.summary: Dell out-of-band boards — works even if the OS is down.
used_for: Remote power and console
Hardware alerts independent of Proxmox

entries.name: TrueNAS
entries.summary: Shared files, datasets, and NAS admin.
used_for: Missing shares or full pools
Snapshots and replication

entries.name: File shares (NFS)
entries.summary: Movies, Anime, Shows, Photos, Timelapse on tn.dataknife.net.
used_for: Linux: sudo mount -t nfs tn.dataknife.net:/mnt/SAS/<Name> /mnt/<name>
Windows: enable Services for NFS, then mount tn.dataknife.net:/mnt/SAS/<Name> Z:
Create the local folder first on Linux (mkdir). Unmount with umount / sudo umount.

entries.name: Brother HL-L2460DW
entries.summary: Network printer via AirPrint / IPP on the lab LAN.
used_for: Linux: lpadmin -p Brother-HL-L2460DW -E -v ipp://BRW502E6685EFE7.local/ipp/print -m everywhere
Windows: Settings → Printers & scanners → Add device, or add IPP URL http://BRW502E6685EFE7.local:631/ipp/print
Admin page: http://BRW502E6685EFE7.local/

entries.name: NAS / RustFS
entries.summary: S3-compatible object storage.
used_for: App buckets and backup destinations

entries.name: Proxmox Backup
entries.summary: Guest and host backup appliance.
used_for: Backup jobs and restores for VMs/LXCs

entries.name: Rancher
entries.summary: Kubernetes cluster manager.
used_for: Cluster inventory and GitOps targets

entries.name: Harbor
entries.summary: Private container images.
used_for: Image pull failures during deploys

entries.name: Coder
entries.summary: Browser workspaces for humans and agents.
used_for: Start or recover a workspace when someone cannot code

entries.name: Authentik
entries.summary: Single sign-on for lab apps.
used_for: Login problems across many sites at once

entries.name: Palworld
entries.summary: Join palworld.dataknife.net:8211 (UDP). Admin UI at https://palworld.dataknife.net/.
used_for: Players: Join Multiplayer → direct connect + join password
Operators: admin UI basic auth (admin / admin-password) — do not share with players

entries.name: Windrose
entries.summary: Join windrose.dataknife.net:7777 (TCP+UDP).
used_for: Play → Connect to Server with host:port (or invite code if configured)
Operator docs: DataKnifeAI/windrose-server-k8s

entries.name: Satisfactory
entries.summary: Join satisfactory.dataknife.net:7777 (TCP+UDP).
used_for: Server Manager → Add Server → host + port 7777
Operator docs: DataKnifeAI/satisfactory-server-k8s

entries.name: Pulseblade
entries.summary: Deeper findings and gated remediation.
used_for: Why a DockFire tile went red
Agent-facing MCP + human triage

entries.name: DockFire
entries.summary: This page — catalog, health, and deep links.
used_for: Find what exists and whether it answers
Jump straight into the right UI

entries.name: UniFi
entries.summary: Wi-Fi / LAN controller (often LAN-only).
used_for: Clients offline, AP issues, LAN policy

entries.name: PDU
entries.summary: Rack power outlets (LAN-only).
used_for: Remote power cycle — carefully, and only when asked

notes: DockFire never stores passwords, tokens, or API keys.
Reachability is resolve+TCP from the cluster — not a full login test.
LAN-only admin URLs stay out of public git and mount at deploy time when needed.
Prefer GitHub for public DockFire discussion; GitLab is the internal mirror.
